queries.query: I keep putting off the thing that matters most.
I said I would do it and then I didn't.
I'm scared of failing in front of everyone.
I keep comparing myself to people who are further ahead.
I lose my temper with the people closest to me.
How do I stay consistent when motivation runs out?
I have too many priorities and finish none of them.
I'm avoiding a conversation I know I need to have.
I spend too much money when I'm stressed.
I feel like I'm behind everyone my age.
I can't say no to people.
I keep making excuses for not training.
I'm exhausted but I still feel guilty for resting.
I want to be taken seriously at work.
I scroll for hours instead of going to bed.
I don't trust myself to follow through any more.
Someone criticised my work and I want to give up.
How do I decide what to drop when everything feels urgent?
I keep starting over instead of continuing.
I want to stop lying to myself about how it's going.
